The company

What is 2DY?

2DY is a company with strong family foundations and many years of experience in metalworking. Formally established in 2020, 2DY continues the work of 2DY sh.p.k., carrying forward the commitment, the professionalism and the tradition built up over the years by the previous generation.

Over time, 2DY has grown into a multidisciplinary company and widened its fields of activity.

The expanded fields of activity:

  • Architectural and engineering design
  • Development of construction projects
  • Professional technical consultancy
  • Supervision of construction works
  • Renovation of commercial buildings and family properties

Our aim is to deliver durable, functional and contemporary solutions, combining traditional experience in metalworking with a modern approach to architecture and engineering.

Our mission

Mission

Our mission

The mission of 2DY is to provide professional, durable and tailored solutions in design, metalworking, site supervision and renovation. Through a commitment to quality, efficiency and innovation, we set out to build functional, well-considered spaces that serve the needs of our clients, in the private sector and the commercial one alike. 2DY works to be a dependable partner that brings value and confidence to every project it takes on, drawing on many years of experience.
